user: Design a support ring that holds a round-bottom flask above the bench. A flat ring (annulus) with an outer diameter of 90 mm and an inner diameter of 66 mm, 6 mm thick, has its top face at z = 60 and is centred on the Z axis. Three round legs, each 6 mm in diameter, run straight down from the ring to the bed at z = 0. Their axes lie on a 78 mm diameter circle, 120 degrees apart, the first on the +X axis.

Design a spacer for raising a circuit board with a socket-head screw sunk into it. It is a cylinder 24 mm in diameter and 12 mm tall standing on the bed (z = 0 to 12), centred on the origin. A 3.4 mm hole runs through its full height on the axis, and from the top face a coaxial counterbore 6.5 mm in diameter goes 5 mm deep (from z = 7 to z = 12).

Design a sliding mount with a dovetail rail. A flat base plate 60 mm long (X), 40 mm wide (Y) and 6 mm thick lies on the bed (z = 0 to 6), centred on the origin. Along its full length, centred on y = 0, runs a dovetail rail on top of the plate: its cross-section (in the YZ plane) is a trapezoid 10 mm wide where it meets the plate at z = 6 and 14 mm wide at its top face at z = 12, so it flares outward as it rises.

Design a weighted base for a lab stand rod. A flat disc 100 mm in diameter and 10 mm thick lies on the bed (z = 0 to 10), centred on the origin. On its top, a coaxial round boss 20 mm in diameter rises from z = 10 to z = 30. A 8.5 mm diameter hole for the rod goes down the axis from the top of the boss to 2 mm above the bed, so the bottom stays closed.

Design a wedge that keeps a lab door open. It is a right-angled wedge 120 mm long (X), 40 mm wide (Y) and 25 mm tall: its cross-section in the XZ plane is a right triangle with corners at (x = 0, z = 0), (x = 120, z = 0) and (x = 0, z = 25), extruded along Y from y = 0 to y = 40. A straight slot 6 mm wide (Y) and 30 mm long (X), centred at x = 60, y = 20, runs vertically through the whole wedge.

Design a set of 4 identical spacer washers that print together. Each washer is a flat ring 30 mm in outer diameter with a 10.5 mm hole, 2 mm thick, lying on the bed. Place them in a single row along X with a 8 mm gap between neighbouring washers, all centred on y = 0, and centre the whole row on the origin. The washers are separate parts and must not touch.

Design a rest for glass stirring rods. It is a rectangular block 50 mm long (X), 30 mm wide (Y) and 15 mm tall, standing on the bed and centred on the origin in X and Y. Across its top face cut 3 V-shaped grooves that each run the full width along Y, 15 mm apart centre to centre and centred along X. Each groove has a 90-degree V profile, 8 mm wide at the top surface and 4 mm deep.

Design a clamping block that holds a hex nut captive. It is a rectangular block 30 mm (X) by 24 mm (Y) by 15 mm (Z), centred on the origin in X and Y and resting on z = 0. A 5.5 mm hole runs vertically through its centre. From the bottom face, a hexagonal pocket 8.2 mm across the flats and 4.2 mm deep is cut around the same axis, with two of its flats parallel to the X axis.

Design a split collet that grips a tube. It is a round tube 30 mm in outer diameter with a 25 mm bore, standing on the bed from z = 0 to z = 20, centred on the Z axis. 6 straight slots, each 2 mm wide, are cut through the wall from the top end down to z = 10; they run along the axis and are evenly spaced around it, the first centred on the +X axis.

Design a cross-shaped stabiliser that sits under a tall bottle. It is a flat plate 3 mm thick lying on the bed, shaped like a plus sign centred on the origin: one bar 70 mm long along X and one bar 70 mm long along Y, both 10 mm wide, crossing at their middles. A 4.5 mm hole goes through the centre, and another 4.5 mm hole goes through each of the four arm ends, centred 30 mm from the origin.

Design a wall plate that hangs on a screw head through a keyhole slot. It is a flat plate 70 mm long (X), 35 mm wide (Y) and 3 mm thick, lying on the bed with its centre at the origin. The keyhole is cut through the plate: a round hole 10 mm in diameter centred at x = 0, y = 0, joined to a straight slot 4 mm wide that runs from that centre in the +X direction to a rounded end whose centre is at x = 10, y = 0.

Design a stepped riser for setting samples at different heights. It is a solid staircase of 3 equal steps, standing on the bed. Seen from the side (the XZ plane) the profile climbs in the +X direction: each step is 15 mm long in X and 6 mm higher than the one before, from a first step of height 6 at x = 0 to x = 15, up to a top step of height 18 ending at x = 45. The profile is extruded 40 mm along Y, from y = 0 to y = 40, and every step is solid down to the bed.

Design a small display base with bevelled top edges. It is a rectangular block 100 mm (X) by 50 mm (Y) by 15 mm (Z), centred on the origin in X and Y and standing on z = 0. All four top edges carry a 45-degree chamfer 4 mm wide, so the top face measures 92 by 42 mm and the vertical sides stop at z = 11. The bottom edges stay sharp.

Design a label tag for a gas cylinder. It is a flat plate 50 mm long (X), 25 mm wide (Y) and 3 mm thick, lying on the bed with its centre at the origin, and all four corners (seen from above) are rounded with a 5 mm radius. A 6 mm hole for a cable tie goes through the plate at x = -19, y = 0.
